summary.text: Bradley Bettencourt is the Republican candidate for the Arizona House of Representatives, District 9, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a former bank credit officer and real estate investor who lives in Dobson Ranch.

paragraphs.text: Bettencourt said in the survey that he holds bachelor's and master's degrees from Arizona State University and worked as a credit analyst and credit officer at banks, including in Yuma and Nogales.
He said he runs his own business, focused largely on real estate investment, with operations in three states.
Bettencourt said he is president of Dobson Ranch, a community built around man-made lakes.
He advanced from the Republican primary on July 21, 2026.
He listed cost of living, water and housing affordability as his key campaign messages, and named public safety and fiscal responsibility among his priorities.
